name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
steps: Take a staggered stance, hinge at your hips and brace a forearm on your front thigh.
Hold the dumbbell in your opposite hand and let that arm hang beneath your shoulder, palm inward.
Pull the dumbbell back toward your hip by driving your elbow close to your ribs and squeezing your lat and upper back.
Lower the dumbbell smoothly to full arm extension, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your shoulders and hips square to the floor instead of twisting your torso to heave the weight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip rather than straight up toward your chest.
